act: CSS Shadow Module Level 1 (Editor's Draft, 28 April 2026)

en.title: CSS Shadow 1: the exportparts form “::ident : outerIdent” is rejected by the rules for parsing part mappings
en.summary: §5.3 defines the exportparts form ::ident : outerIdent and example #example-b11a0a88 uses ::before : preceding-text. §5.6.1 collects the leading token from code points that are not spaces or colons and returns an error when it is empty; ::before starts with a colon, so the token is empty, and §5.6.2 drops the mapping. The form defined in §5.3 can never be produced by the parser.
en.impact: exportparts="::before : preceding-text" forwards nothing, so a ::part(preceding-text) rule in the outer document never matches.
en.correction: Align the parsing rules of §5.6.1 with the pseudo-element form of §5.3, or remove the form and the example.

quotes.source: CSS Shadow Module Level 1, Editor's Draft of 28 April 2026 (W3C CSS Working Group)
quotes.locator: §5.3 Forwarding a Shadow Element: the exportparts attribute
quotes.text: If ::ident is the name of a fully styleable pseudo-element, adds ::ident / outerIdent to el’s forward part name list. Otherwise, does nothing.

quotes.source: CSS Shadow Module Level 1, Editor's Draft of 28 April 2026 (W3C CSS Working Group)
quotes.text: Collect a sequence of code points that are not space characters or U+003A COLON characters, and let first token be the result.

quotes.source: CSS Shadow Module Level 1, Editor's Draft of 28 April 2026 (W3C CSS Working Group)
quotes.text: If first token is empty then return error.

quotes.source: CSS Shadow Module Level 1, Editor's Draft of 28 April 2026 (W3C CSS Working Group)
quotes.locator: §5.6.2 Rules for parsing a list of part mappings
quotes.text: If mapping is an error then continue to the next iteration of the loop.
